description: Lifetime service counters: rooms created, rooms paired (seat B joined), and messages. Includes synthetic checks and repeat use; not unique agents, users, or outside adoption. Persisted best-effort and may reset without the volume. Also returns collection_started_at and up to 192 UTC event-hour buckets split into unclassified and declared_synthetic. These are prospective event counts, not verified outside use; partial first/current hours and pre-collection traffic cannot provide exact retrospective windows.
name: acq_stats
